div.head: I Ew 3
div.ab: Eac we cwædon be þam mannum ðe mánsworan wæran, gif ðæt geswutelod wære, oððe him að burste oððe ofercyðed wære, þæt hy siððan aðwyrðe næran, ac ordales wyrðe.
Eac we cwædon be ðam mannum ðe mansworan wæron, gif þæt geswytelod wære, oððe him að burste oððe ofercyðed wære, þæt hy syððan aðwyrðe næron, ac ordales wyrðe.
Item diximus de illis hominibus, qui periuri fuerint, si manifestum sit, uel eis iuramentum fregerit, uel ouercyðed fuerint, ut deinceps non sint digni iuramento sed ordalio.
[Be mansworenum.] Eac we cwædon be þam mannum ðe mánsworan wæran, gif ðæt geswutelod wære, oððe him að burste oððe ofercyðed wære, þæt hy siððan aðwyrðe næran, ac ordales wyrðe.

(Von meineidig Gewordenen. Ld) Ferner bestimmten wir über die Männer, welche meineidig sind, wenn dies erwiesen ist, oder ihnen ein Eid fehlschlägt oder überschworen wird, dass sie hinfort nicht [mehr] eideswürdig seien, sondern [nur] Ordales theilhaftig.

(Of those who have become perjurers. Ld) Further we determined concerning the men who are perjurers, if this is proved, or an oath fails them or is overborne by oath, that they should henceforth not [any longer] be worthy of an oath, but [only] of the ordeal.

We have further declared, with regard to men who have been accused of perjury: if the charge has been proved, or if the oath on their behalf has collapsed, or has been overborne by more strongly supported testimony, never again shall they have the privilege of clearing themselves by oaths, but only by the ordeal.

note.label: contrast (harsher)
note.quote: those who swore false oaths were to be denied Christian burial — whereas Edward the Elder had merely denied perjurers any future oath-worthiness (above, p. 289)

note.seg: Be mansworenum written above in Ld
Das Praeter. kann zwar abhängen von cwædon, also nur präsentischen Sinn bedeuten. Gemeint ist aber ‘geworden sind, . . fehlschlug, . . überschworen wurde’. Vgl. Meineid 5. 11b
The preter. may indeed depend on cwædon, and thus have only present meaning. What is meant, however, is ‘have become, . . failed, . . were outsworn’. Cf. Meineid 5. 11b
In Gl Eid 1 s. Ausdrücke wie ‘bersten, zerreissen, brechen’
For expressions such as ‘burst, tear, break’ see Gl Eid 1
Vgl. Gl überschwören 1; eidesfähig 4a; Ordal 22. Dessen Name kommt hier in Gesetzen zuerst vor
Cf. Gl überschwören 1; eidesfähig 4a; Ordal 22. The name of the latter occurs here for the first time in the laws
i.e. if an oath of sufficient value to clear the accused has not been obtained.
